LangChain excels in complex, highly customizable applications with extensive tool integrations, while CrewAI offers speed and scalability for role-based workflows. AutoGen is best for conversational and code-driven agent systems, balancing concurrency and reliability.
key_points: LangChain has over 600+ integrations and can connect to virtually every major LLM, tool, and database via a standardized interface.
CrewAI takes a hybrid approach to integration, offering ready-made tools and custom logic, branching, and external Python functions.
AutoGen keeps its integration story lean but capable, mixing model providers and tools cleanly and slotting human input into the loop when you want it.
LangChain is quick in simple flows, though overhead creeps in as you chain more agents together.
CrewAI borrows the entire LangChain tool library and adds its own ready-made tools, treating Model Context Protocol support as a first-class feature.
